prakrit: सव्वेसिं विज्जा वड्ढउ।
english: May the knowledge of all increase.,

prakrit: जहिं धम्मो तहिं सुक्खं।
english: Where there is dharma, there is happiness.,

prakrit: अप्पाणं णिग्गहं कुणह।
english: Control yourself.,

prakrit: जो सच्चं वयइ सो सच्चं लहेइ।
english: One who speaks truth finds truth.,

prakrit: सव्वेसिं बुद्धी वड्ढउ।
english: May the wisdom of all increase.,

prakrit: अप्पाणं उद्धरह।
english: Uplift yourself.,

prakrit: जो सेवइ सो सुहं लहेइ।
english: One who serves attains happiness.,

prakrit: सव्वेसिं सद्धा वड्ढउ।
english: May the faith of all increase.,

prakrit: जहिं सच्चं तहिं सुक्खं।
english: Where there is truth, there is happiness.,

prakrit: अप्पाणं जागरह।
english: Awaken yourself.,

prakrit: सव्वेसिं वीरिया वड्ढउ।
english: May the energy of all increase.,

prakrit: जहिं धम्मो तहिं जओ।
english: Where there is dharma, there is victory.,

prakrit: अप्पाणं समं कुणह।
english: Equalize yourself.,

prakrit: जो खमइ सो जयइ।
english: One who forgives wins.,

prakrit: सव्वेसिं सती वड्ढउ।
english: May the mindfulness of all increase.,

prakrit: अप्पाणं मुंचह।
english: Free yourself.,

prakrit: जो सिक्खइ सो जाणइ।
english: One who learns knows.,

prakrit: सव्वेसिं समाही वड्ढउ।
english: May the concentration of all increase.,

prakrit: जहिं करुणा तहिं धम्मो।
english: Where there is compassion, there is dharma.,

prakrit: अप्पाणं बोहेहि।
english: Enlighten yourself.,

prakrit: सव्वेसिं पञ्ञा वड्ढउ।
english: May the wisdom of all increase.,

prakrit: जहिं सच्चं तहिं बलं।
english: Where there is truth, there is strength.,

prakrit: अप्पाणं णिब्बुयं कुणह।
english: Make yourself peaceful.,

prakrit: जो मित्तं लहेइ सो धणं लहेइ।
english: One who finds a friend finds wealth.,

prakrit: सव्वेसिं खंती वड्ढउ।
english: May the patience of all increase.,

prakrit: जहिं धम्मो तहिं सच्चं।
english: Where there is dharma, there is truth.,

prakrit: अप्पाणं सुद्धं कुणह।
english: Purify yourself.,

prakrit: जो सेवइ सो सिक्खइ।
english: One who serves learns.,

prakrit: सव्वेसिं मेत्ती वड्ढउ।
english: May the friendliness of all increase.,

prakrit: जहिं पेम्मं तहिं सच्चं।
english: Where there is love, there is truth.,

prakrit: जो दयं करेइ सो सुहं लहेइ।
english: One who shows compassion attains happiness.,

prakrit: सव्वेसिं करुणा वड्ढउ।
english: May the compassion of all increase.,

prakrit: जहा चिंता तहा वाया, जहा वाया तहा किरिया।
english: As the thought, so the speech; as the speech, so the action.,

prakrit: णाणं परमं बलं, अण्णाणं परमं दुब्बलत्तं।
english: Knowledge is supreme strength, ignorance is supreme weakness.,

prakrit: कम्मं चेव कारणं, फलं तस्स अणुरूवं।
english: Action alone is the cause, the fruit is according to it.,

prakrit: सच्चमेव जयइ णाणृतं, सच्चेण पंथो विततो देवयाणः।
english: Truth alone triumphs, not falsehood; by truth the divine path is spread.,

prakrit: सव्वं अणिच्चं, णाणं णिच्चं, एसो परमो सिद्धंतो।
english: Everything is impermanent, knowledge is permanent; this is the supreme principle.,

prakrit: जहा मणो तहा वाणी, जहा वाणी तहा करणं।
english: As the mind, so the speech; as the speech, so the action.,

prakrit: पेम्मेण सव्वं जयइ, दोसेण सव्वं णस्सइ।
english: Love conquers all, hatred destroys all.,

prakrit: अप्पसंतोसो महादोसो, संतोसो परमं सुहं।
english: Discontent is a great fault, contentment is the highest happiness.,

prakrit: जो धम्मं रक्खइ सो रक्खिज्जइ, एसो धम्मस्स महिमा।
english: One who protects dharma is protected; this is the glory of dharma.,

prakrit: सुहस्स मूलं संतोसो, दुक्खस्स मूलं लोभो।
english: Contentment is the root of happiness, greed is the root of sorrow.,

prakrit: जहा रूवं तहा गुणो, जहा गुणो तहा फलं।
english: As the form, so the quality; as the quality, so the fruit.,

prakrit: सव्वेसिं संति होउ, सव्वेसिं सुहं होउ।
english: May there be peace for all, may there be happiness for all.,

prakrit: अप्पाणं जिणह, तेण सव्वं जिणिस्ससि।
english: Conquer yourself, by that you will conquer all.,

prakrit: जेण संतोसो तेण धणं, असंतुट्ठो सया दलिद्दो।
english: One who is content is wealthy, the discontented is always poor.,

prakrit: जहा बीयं वुत्तं तहा फलं लब्भइ, एसो पयडीए णियमो।
english: As the seed is sown, so is the fruit obtained; this is nature's law.,

prakrit: जो सच्चं रक्खइ तं सच्चं रक्खइ, एसो सच्चस्स महिमा।
english: One who protects truth is protected by truth; this is the glory of truth.,

prakrit: सव्वेसिं दुक्खाणं खया होंतु, सव्वेसिं सुहाणं वुड्ढी होउ।
english: May all sorrows be destroyed, may all happiness increase.,

prakrit: जहिं पेम्मं तहिं धम्मो, जहिं धम्मो तहिं पेम्मं।
english: Where there is love, there is dharma; where there is dharma, there is love.,

prakrit: अप्पाणं उज्जोएहि, तेण लोओ उज्जोइज्जिस्सइ।
english: Illuminate yourself, by that the world will be illuminated.,

prakrit: जेण संतुट्ठो तेण धणवंतो, असंतुट्ठो णिच्चं दरिद्दो।
english: One who is satisfied is wealthy, the unsatisfied is always poor.,

prakrit: सव्वेसिं सुहाइं वड्ढंतु, दुक्खाइं विणस्संतु।
english: May the happiness of all increase, may sorrows be destroyed.,

prakrit: जो मित्तं रक्खइ सो अप्पाणं रक्खइ, मित्तं परमं रक्खणं।
english: One who protects a friend protects oneself; a friend is the supreme protection.,

prakrit: पयडीए सेवा मणुस्सस्स सेवा, पयडी अम्हाणं जणणी।
english: Service to nature is service to humanity; nature is our mother.,

prakrit: जहिं दया तहिं धम्मो, जहिं धम्मो तहिं मोक्खो।
english: Where there is compassion, there is dharma; where there is dharma, there is liberation.,

prakrit: सव्वे जीवा कम्म-बद्धा।
english: All souls are bound by karma.,

prakrit: सच्चं भणे, मिच्छं ण भणे।
english: Speak the truth, do not speak falsehood.,

prakrit: अप्पाणं पि पियं मण्णे।
english: Consider oneself as dear.,

prakrit: सव्वेसिं भूयाणं दया कायव्वा।
english: Compassion should be shown to all beings.,

prakrit: णाणेण सव्वं पयासइ।
english: Everything is illuminated by knowledge.,

prakrit: कम्मं खवेइ सुद्धप्पा।
english: The pure soul destroys karma.,

prakrit: संसारो दुक्खमूलो।
english: The cycle of rebirth is the root of suffering.,

prakrit: मोक्खो परमं सुक्खं।
english: Liberation is the highest happiness.

prakrit: जीवो अणंतणाणी।
english: The soul has infinite knowledge.,

prakrit: कम्मं जीवस्स वेरी।
english: Karma is the enemy of the soul.,

prakrit: सम्मत्तं मोक्खमग्गो।
english: Right belief is the path to liberation.,

prakrit: अप्पा सो परमप्पा।
english: The self is the supreme self.,

prakrit: सव्वे जीवा समाणा।
english: All souls are equal.,

prakrit: अहिंसा सव्वधम्माणं मूलं।
english: Non-violence is the root of all dharmas.,

prakrit: लोभो पावस्स कारणं।
english: Greed is the cause of sin.,

prakrit: तवसा किलिस्सइ अप्पा।
english: The soul is purified through penance.,

prakrit: सम्मदंसण-णाण-चरित्ताणि मोक्खमग्गो।
english: Right vision, knowledge, and conduct are the path to liberation.,

prakrit: इंदियाणि जेइ जो, सो जिणो।
english: One who conquers the senses is a conqueror.,

prakrit: जीवो अमरो।
english: The soul is immortal.,

prakrit: कोहो महा-विसं।
english: Anger is a great poison.,

prakrit: माणो दुक्खस्स मूलं।
english: Pride is the root of suffering.,

prakrit: माया पावस्स जणणी।
english: Deceit is the mother of sin.,

prakrit: दाणं परमं बलं।
english: Charity is the supreme strength.,

prakrit: मग्गं सव्वं जाणइ।
english: He knows the path to everything.,

prakrit: अहिंसा लोए जाणइ।
english: Non-violence is known in the world.,

prakrit: धम्मे लोए पंचव्रतं जाणइ।
english: He knows the five vows of Dharma in the world.,

prakrit: जीवं पंचव्रतं जाणइ।
english: He knows life through the five vows.,

prakrit: अहिंसा पंचव्रतं जाणइ।
english: Non-violence is known through the five vows.,

prakrit: लोके पंचमहाव्रतं जाणइ।
english: He knows the five great vows in the world.,

prakrit: लोए पंचमहाव्रती जाणइ।
english: He knows everything in the world through the five great vows.,

prakrit: जीवं पंचमहाव्रती जाणइ।
english: He knows life through the five great vows.,

prakrit: धम्मे पंचव्रतं जाणइ।
english: He knows everything through Dharma's five vows.,

prakrit: जीवं अहिंसा जाणइ पंचव्रतं।
english: Life and non-violence are known through the five vows.,

prakrit: धम्मे अहिंसा पंचमहाव्रतं जाणइ।
english: Non-violence is known in Dharma through the five great vows.,

prakrit: लोके पंचमहाव्रतं जाणइ अहिंसा।
english: In the world, non-violence is known through the five great vows.,

prakrit: धम्मे पंचमहाव्रती जाणइ लोए।
english: The observer of the five great vows knows everything in Dharma.,

prakrit: जीवं पंचमहाव्रतं जाणइ सव्वं।
english: He knows life and everything through the five great vows.,

prakrit: लोए पंचमहाव्रतं जाणइ धम्मं।
english: In the world, the five great vows and Dharma are known.,

prakrit: धम्मे पंचव्रतं जाणइ सव्वं।
english: Everything is known through the five vows in Dharma.,

prakrit: धम्मे सव्वं जाणइ पंचमहाव्रतं।
english: Everything is known in Dharma through the five great vows.,

prakrit: अज्जए विय ममस्सं सुहस्स संपत्तिओ
english: Today my heart overflows with joy.

prakrit: जस्सेते लोगंसि कम्मसमारंभा परिण्णाया भवंति, से हु मुणी परिण्णायकम्मे ।
english: He who, in the world, comprehends and renounces these causes of sin, is called a reward-knowing sage (muni). Thus I say.

prakrit: तत्थ खलु भगवया परिण्णा पवेइया । इमस्स चेव जीवियस्स परिवंदण माणण पूयणाए, जाई मरण मोयणाए, दुक्खपडिघाय हेउं । एयावंति सव्वावंति लोगंसि कम्मसमारंभा परिजाणियव्वा भवंति ।
english: About this the Revered One has taught the truth (comprehension and renunciation). For the sake of the splendour, honour, and glory of this life, for the sake of birth, death, and final liberation, for the removal of pain, all these causes of sin are at work, which are to be comprehended and renounced in this world.

prakrit: सुय मे आउसं ! तेणं भगवया एवमक्खायं - इहमेगेसिं णो सण्णा भवइ ।
english: O long-lived (Jambuswami)! I (Sudharman) have heard the following discourse from the venerable (Mahavira).

prakrit: अकरिस्सं च हं, कारवेसुं च हं, करओ यावि समणुण्णे भविस्सामि । एयावंति सव्वावंति लोगंसि कम्मसमारंभा परिजाणियव्वा भवंति ।
english: He believes in soul, believes in the world, believes in reward, believes in action (acknowledged to be our own doing in such judgments as these): 'I did it;' 'I shall cause another to do it;' 'I shall allow another to do it.' In the world, these are all the causes of sin, which must be comprehended and renounced.

prakrit: से जं पुण जाणेज्जा सहसम्मइयाए परवागरणेणं अण्णेसिं वा अतिए सोच्चा, तं जहा - पुरत्थिमाओ वा दिसाओ आगओ अहमंसि जाव अण्णयरीओ दिसाओ वा अणुदिसाओ वा आगओ अहमंसि । एवमेगेसिं जं णायं भवइ । अत्थि मे आया उववाइए, जो इमाओ दिसाओ वा अणुदिसाओ वा अणुसंचरइ, सव्वाओ दिसाओ सव्वाओ अणुदिसाओ जो आगओ अणुसंचरइ, सोऽहं । से आयावाई लोयावाई कम्मावाई किरियावाई ।
english: Now this is what one should know, either by one's own knowledge or through the instruction of the highest (i.e. a Tîrthakara), or having heard it from others: that he descended in an eastern direction, or in any other direction (particularised above). Similarly, some know that their soul is born again and again, that it arrives in this or that direction, whatever direction that may be.

prakrit: तं जहा --- पुरत्थिमाओ वा दिसाओ आगओ अहमंसि, दाहिणाओ वा दिसाओ आगओ अहमंसि, पच्चत्थिमाओ वा दिसाओ आगओ अहमंसि, उत्तराओ वा दिसाओ आगओ अहमंसि, उड्ढाओ वा दिसाओ आगओ अहमंसि, अहे दिसाओ वा आगओ अहमंसि, अण्णयरीओ दिसाओ वा अणुदिसाओ वा आगओ अहमंसि । एवमेगेसिं णो णायं भवइ । अस्थि मे आया उववाइए, णत्थि मे आया उववाइए, के अहं आसी, के वा इओ चुओ इह पेच्चा भविस्सामि ।
english: Here many do not remember whether they have descended in an eastern direction (when they were born in this world), or in a southern, or in a western, or in a northern direction, or in the direction from above, or in the direction from below, or in a direction intermediate (between the cardinal points), or in a direction intermediate between these (and the cardinal points). Similarly, some do not know whether their soul is born again and again or not; nor what they were formerly, nor what they will become after having died and left this world.

prakrit: अपरिण्णायकम्मे खलु अयं पुरिसे, जो इमाओ दिसाओ वा अणुदिसाओ वा अणुसंचरइ, सव्वाओ दिसाओ सव्वाओ अणुदिसाओ साहेइ, अणेगरूवाओ जोणीओ संधेइ, विरूवरूवे फासे पडिसंवेदेइ ।
english: A man that does not comprehend and renounce the causes of sin, descends in a cardinal or intermediate direction, wanders to all cardinal or intermediate directions, is born again and again in manifold births, experiences all painful feelings.

prakrit: से बेमि — णेव सयं लोगं अब्भाइक्खेज्जा, णेव अत्ताणं अब्भाइक्खेज्जा । जे लोगं अब्भाइक्खइ, से अत्ताणं अब्भाइक्खइ । जे अत्ताणं अब्भाइक्खइ, से लोगं अब्भाइक्खइ । जे दीहलोगसत्थस्स खेयण्णे, से असत्थस्स खेयण्णे । जे असत्थस्स खेयण्णे, से दीहलोगसत्थस्स खेयण्णे ।
english: That liberation-seeking soul never prohibits the existence of any fire body. It does not deny even its own soul, because one who deny fire, it deny itself. He who deny himself, denies the world of fire bodies.

prakrit: संति पंच महब्भूया, इहमेगेसिमाहिया । पुढवी आऊ तेऊ वा, वाऊ आगास पंचमा ॥
english: <!-- <sutra-glossary> <dl> </dl> </sutra-glossary> <sutra-explanation> </sutra-explanation> -->

prakrit: जहा य पुढवीथूभे, एगे णाणाहि दीसइ । एवं भो ! कसिणे लोए, विण्णु णाणाहि दीसइ ॥
english: <!-- <sutra-glossary> <dl> </dl> </sutra-glossary> <sutra-explanation> </sutra-explanation> -->

prakrit: एते पंच महब्भूया, तेब्भो एगो त्ति आहिया । अह तेसिं विणासेणं, विणासो होइ देहिणो ॥
english: <!-- <sutra-glossary> <dl> </dl> </sutra-glossary> <sutra-explanation> </sutra-explanation> -->

prakrit: एए गंथे विउक्कम्म, एगे समण-माहणा । (अ)याणंता विउस्सित्ता, सत्ता कामेहिं माणवा ॥

prakrit: बुज्झिज्ज तिउट्टेज्जा, बंधणं परिजाणिया । किमाह बंधणं वीरो ? किं वा जाणं तिउट्टइ ॥
english:
Having understood the bondage, one should acquire the knowledge and break it. What did Mahavira considered as bondage? And what is to be known to break (the bondage)?
बुज्झिज्ज

 Intuitively, killing is bad. ❌ Whether you yourself kill someone or cause others to do it, it is still bad. This everyone agrees upon.

But what's strange is that despite common consensus towards not killing anyone, there still exists majority of people who kill to eat. Fortunately, the number of people adopting vegetarianism and even veganism is rising globally 💚.

Back to the sutra. Note that the sutra doesn't talk of any sin or any such abstract concept. It says kill (or cause to kill) and you will increase your enmity. Why? Because no living being wants to be killed. If you kill it, naturally it is not going to like it and project its helpless anger towards you. So, why is it bad? After all the animal is dead; what can it do now? That's a wrong question to ask because it is not about revenge. Irrespective of what the animal can or cannot do, you have tarnished your soul; you have become a killer. A soul heavy with such karmic bondage of enmity cannot be free. So do not kill anyone not only because it is bad inherently, but also because killing will hamper your goal of soul's liberation.

 Note that non-possession (अपरिग्रह) is one of the five cardinal values of Jain monks, others being non-violence, truth, chastity, and non-stealing. ### Begin with non-possession This sutra simply states that one who possesses anything --- be it animal, person, thing or for that matter even frivolous item like chaff --- cannot be free from sorrows. So by logic, to be happy, one must stop possessing things. Thus, Jain monks do not possess anything --- no money, property, and Digambars not even clothes. Now, for a lay person living in real world, this seems impossible (after all this sutra is meant for the monks). But you too can imbibe the essence of the sutra. At least you can start thinking on how to reduce your attachment of material possessions. Do you really need all the hundreds of gadgets, appliances, clothes, etc.? At the next level, if you love someone, love him or her, but don't possess the person. Additionally, note that not only must you yourself not possess anyone but also you should not approve of someone else doing it. ### Moral Simply put, do not possess anything. Just live your life as you came in the world --- with nothing to lose --- and that's the first step towards becoming free from sorrows.
